'''Eleo Duboir''' was a wealthy individual who [[Death/Legends|died]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], leaving his wealth to his twin sons. Both of his children were daredevils, but they were convinced by their father's executor to tone done their activities in order to preserve Duboir's business interests.<ref name="TCM" />
